follow-up time: Until hCG normalization and subsequent pregnancies
outcome: Need for additional treatment (MTX, uterine artery embolization, hysterectomy)
finding: A single local methotrexate injection was found to be a safe and effective treatment for cesarean scar pregnancy, regardless of the presence of fetal cardiac activity or initial hCG levels, with a high success rate and the possibility of subsequent healthy pregnancies.
